Telescope Partners | Software Engineer & Data Scientist | Remote - AMERICAS ONLY | Full-time

Telescope is an early stage growth VC firm with a focus on enterprise software companies. We're a small, efficient team based in SF. We're active investors, working closely with entrepreneurs to help their companies grow. Our tech team is oriented at improving investment decision-making using data, building valuable tools for portcos, and automating investor tasks using agents.

If you're interested in PE, agents, and data science, then this might be a good role for you!

We’re looking for someone with 3-10 years of experience.

To apply email mike at telescopepartners.com
